intent_signatures: grab official documentation for a domain
ingest llms.txt, openapi, ai-plugin, robots, well-known manifests
produce docs_prior cells that seed new atomic cells with a priori knowledge
usage_instructions: bash scripts/cell-build/cells/docs-hunter/impl.sh <domain> → writes .bench-local/docs-hunter/<domain>.json. Fetches every well-known doc location, categorises what was found, produces a DocsBlob suitable for minting docs_prior cells.

extraction.note: probes each source, records status + size + content-type + first 200 bytes of body (redacted). Raw bodies are written to a separate artifact so the cell record stays small.

notes: This is the first concrete cell in the build harness. v0 uses curl. v1 will dogfood by routing through `unbrowse resolve` so the docs-hunter itself is an unbrowse call, closing the loop Lewis described: 'official docs can be grabbed from unbrowse itself'.
